title: FREE STARBUCKS GIFT CARD FOR YOU? YES PLEASE!
description: 'Tis the season to use your insurance!  Don't lose your vision benefits.  Call 905.893.8999 or click http://www.kleinburgvisioncentre.com/ to book your eye exam & get a FREE Starbucks gift card.  Tag a friend that can use this too!

asr.full_text: I'm Doctor Niru Kular and I'm Doctor Nishee Kular and we're from Eyecare Sisters. This is a friendly neighbourhood service announcement from Kleinberg Vision Center did you know that most insurance providers don't let you carry forward your benefits? If you don't use it you lose it! We're local! We're friendly! We're in your neighbourhood and we're really good at what we do Don't lose your Vision benefits!, call us and book an eye exam. Click on the link to get started or call us, and when you do, Santa will send you a $25 Starbucks gift card. Call us, or click on the link to book. Merry Christmas and happy holidays. See you soon!
